title: The Conductor
faceDownEffect: Move the Train 1-2 stops. If it stops at your worker, move 1 Up the Spire.

title: Informant
faceUpEffect: Gain 1 Cred. Look at an opponent's hidden card.
faceDownEffect: If somebody’s worker is at the same train stop; steal 1 coin from them.

title: Merchant
faceDownEffect: If you are at the Market, gain 2 coin.

title: Operator
faceDownEffect: coin: resolve the "Face Down" action of any card currently in your discard pile.

title: Rail Thug
faceUpEffect: Bump an opponent's worker from a station to an adjacent one.
faceDownEffect: If your worker is on the Train, gain 2 coin.

title: Scrapper
faceDownEffect: You might buy a card from the Scrapyard for free.

title: Politician
faceUpEffect: Access to the Forum for coin.
faceDownEffect: If you have the most coin, move 1 up on the Spire.

title: Mechanic
faceDownEffect: If you have the most Cog: Gain coin and move the train 1 stop.
